The native Tasks source and its design are described in
[Tasks native Start on Vite+ and Cloudflare](/build/devops/tasks-viteplus-cloudflare).
This page holds the values the release owner needs for the cutover.

## Cutover packet

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Worker | Staging identity `tuturuuu-tasks-vite-staging` is what `void.config.ts` emits. Deploy the production artifact under `tuturuuu-tasks` with the deploy-time name override; the config declares no routes and `workers_dev` is off |
| Host | `tasks.tuturuuu.com` (root mode). `TUTURUUU_STAGING_HOSTS` may add `*.workers.dev` or `*.tuturuuu.com` staging hosts. The apex and every other host get `404`. The `tuturuuu.com/tasks` mount is not part of this cutover |
| Bindings | `ASSETS` (worker-first, `html_handling: none`, so `/offline.html` is read directly) |
| Vars (names) | `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` (read by the server at runtime), `TUTURUUU_STAGING_HOSTS` (staging only) |
| Secrets (names) | `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY`, `TUTURUUU_APP_COORDINATION_SECRET` (required: `503` without them). Optional integrations keep the names in `apps/tasks/env.example` |
| Build | `bun turbo:local run build --filter=@tuturuuu/tasks^...`, then `bun run --cwd apps/tasks build:cloudflare` (`vp build --configLoader runner`). Output: `dist/server/wrangler.json`, `dist/client` |
| Routing | Attach only `tasks.tuturuuu.com/*` |
| Known gap | `serwist/[path]` (the offline service worker) stays on the Next build; the native shell does not register a service worker |
| Prior Vercel deployment | Not recorded in the repository. The release owner captures the production deployment id and DNS record before the flip |

## Rollback

Remove only the `tasks.tuturuuu.com/*` Worker route, or restore the captured DNS
record, so the hostname returns to the captured immutable Vercel deployment.
Do not rebuild and do not promote the Vercel project. The Worker holds no state.

## Smoke

```bash
node scripts/native-cutover/smoke.mjs --origin https://tasks.tuturuuu.com --app tasks --expect native
curl -sI https://tasks.tuturuuu.com/api/build-info    # 200, x-tuturuuu-runtime: native
curl -sI https://tasks.tuturuuu.com/                  # redirect to the central login verify-token URL
```

The smoke runner checks the build-info route, a static file, the unauthenticated
redirect, an API route without a session, the server-function base and the
runtime header. The rollback smoke uses `--expect legacy`. `no 5xx` is part of
every check.

Qualification and the sealed-artifact gate are described on the design page above
(`bun run --cwd apps/tasks test:runtime`, `scripts/ci/tasks-native-artifact.py`).
